bosses.name: Tangmazu, the Raven Trickster
bosses.accessChain: Clear wave 7 of a Simulacrum for a Raven's Reflection, then place it in the mirror at the Withered Willow; one Reflection is consumed per attempt. Every kill drops exactly one of six cheap uniques (Farm of Exile, modelled from 234 kills). Tangmazu's Reliquary Key drops from the Simulacrum, not from Tangmazu — see the Simulacrum row.

bosses.name: The Bodach
bosses.accessChain: Slot five Call of the Shadows into the Effigy at Caer Tarth; all five are consumed. Or self-supply: one Head of the King turns five Atlas maps into Rites of the Nameless, whose final altars drop the five Calls (priced as 1 Head per 5 Calls). Rates from one 100-run Farm of Exile sample (0.5.5) that disagrees with Maxroll's rarity tiers on Carved Tenacity and Vestige of Darkness — both marked unverified; Carved Majesty did not drop in that sample.

bosses.name: The Trialmaster
bosses.accessChain: Run an Inscribed Ultimatum (area level 75+) and spend one Cowardly, one Deadly and one Victorious Fate at the door after the last trial; the Fates are consumed. Since 0.5.5 one Ultimatum can run 30 rooms and yield all three Fates, and the Trialmaster no longer drops Magic Inscribed Ultimatums. The Ultimatum itself is not on the exchange and is not priced here. No drop rates are published.

bosses.accessChain: With Olroth's Saga active, the next level 79+ Logbook guarantees an Olroth encounter (Obscure Island); both are consumed. Every kill drops a Shattered Triskelion — the key to The Aberration. The Logbook's own Expedition loot is not counted, so net understates the run. Unique weights are timesaver.gg's difficulty-4 figures (Heroic Tragedy only at difficulty 4), method unstated.

No drop rates are published, and the Starlit Ores trade in tiny volume.

bosses.name: Xesht, We That Are One
bosses.accessChain: Kill Tul and Esh in a Breach Stronghold revealed by a Breachstone to get a Breachlord Sac, and hand it to the Dreamer in the Monastery of the Keepers; each attempt consumes one Sac. Unresolved: whether 50/100/150 Breach Splinters are ALSO spent to pick a difficulty (timesaver 0.5.4c says yes, expcarry says there are no difficulty options) and which items each higher difficulty adds to the pool (Maxroll: it adds items, it does not multiply rates). No drop rates are published. Breach Rings no longer drop (0.5.0).

bosses.accessChain: Complete a four-trial Djinn Barya (area level 75+) to face Zarokh; the Barya is consumed. Only one of Zarokh's five reliquary keys (Against the Darkness) is listed on poe.ninja.
